verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of acting on many emails at once is Gemini's Organize capability, which can delete multiple emails or add labels from a single request. That is a bulk action in one stroke, but through an AI assistant rather than multi-select. Filters, search operators and the API are automatic rules or developer building blocks, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented multi-select of conversations in the UI, bulk archive, bulk mark-done, and hands-on or independent corroboration of bulk actions.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can select many conversations at once and archive, label, or mark them done in one stroke

citations.quote: Organize: Ask Gemini to do things like delete multiple emails or add labels.
